description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo  District - Cad. Map No. 520001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content focuses on property ownership, land titles, and registration of land rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
